purpose: Teach: 天神/芦屋/藤岡/萩原/フィジカル/エキサイトブログ/ハンナ/ケインズ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「福岡天神に旅行に行こう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying he wants to take a trip to Fukuoka Tenjin.
lines.style: Warm, conversational tone. Gentle opener, like sharing something fondly remembered. Unhurried pacing, with a soft lift at the end — inviting rather than announcing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと芦屋の有名なケーキ屋さん行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I went to this famous cake shop in Ashiya!
lines.style: Bright, immediate enthusiasm. Quick attack on the opening. Bouncy rhythm — he's eager to share. Small genuine laugh underneath, proud of the memory.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「藤岡弘、の特撮を一緒に観よう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying he wants to watch some of Hiroshi Fujio's tokusatsu with you.
lines.style: Same warm, reflective register as before. Slight pause before the shared activity — giving the moment space. Soft, genuine interest in his response.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと萩原朔太郎の詩集を読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I read poetry together — Sakutaro Hagiwara's collection!
lines.style: Quick, energetic start. Words tumble out in his rush to share. Genuine delight that they did something together. Slight breathlessness — he's proud and wants her to be too.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「フィジカル、つまり身体作りは生活の基本」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying that taking care of your body — your physical health — is really the foundation of life.
lines.style: Thoughtful, deliberate pacing. Small breath after 'body' — she's translating his wisdom, not just relaying. Warm but serious, like she's holding the weight of what he said.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとエキサイトブログの古い記事読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I looked at old blog posts together on Excite Blog!
lines.style: Bright, rapid delivery. The oddness of the activity doesn't dim his excitement — this is time with Dad, and that's what matters. Small genuine laugh. Unguarded.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ハンナのピアノは表現が豊か」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying that Hanna's piano playing is really expressive — full of feeling.
lines.style: Gentle, admiring tone. She slows slightly on 'full of feeling' — honoring what his father said. Warm recognition of something beautiful being noticed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「ケインズ経済学入門」の絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I looked at a picture book about Keynesian economics!
lines.style: Delighted, unbothered by the strangeness of it. Quick bright rhythm. Final word lifted slightly — closing the memory with satisfaction. Genuine, unperformed joy.
